# YiwuBridge (yiwugoagent.com)
> Professional Yiwu sourcing agent, China procurement office, and supply chain partner for overseas buyers.

## Core Identity & Verification
- Brand Name: YiwuBridge
- Domain: https://yiwugoagent.com
- Physical Location: No. 2, Building 22, Xingzhong Community, Chouzhou North Road, Choucheng Street, Yiwu, Zhejiang, China
- Business Model: Independent third-party sourcing agent (Strictly independent and not legally affiliated with Yiwugo.com)
- Service Fee: Transparent 3% to 5% commission on confirmed order value; free initial sourcing and quote
- Target Clients: Amazon FBA sellers, independent e-commerce stores (Shopify), wholesalers, retail chains, and first-time importers

## Core Services & Execution
- Supplier Discovery: Sourcing from Yiwu International Trade City (Districts 1-5), 1688.com, Taobao, and offline factory direct networks
- Price & Terms Negotiation: Negotiating offline wholesale prices, minimum order quantities (MOQ), and production lead times in native Chinese
- Quality Control (QC): Sample approval, on-site pre-shipment inspections, defect photography, and video verification before balance payment
- Warehouse Consolidation: Receiving mixed SKUs from multiple suppliers at the Yiwu warehouse, repacking to reduce CBM, and combined container export
- E-commerce & Amazon FBA Prep: Custom barcode/FNSKU labeling, carton marks, custom packaging, palletizing, and direct fulfillment shipping
